title: Behavioral and Electrophysiological Effects of Ketamine in Treatment-Resistant Depression
brief_summary: The overarching goal of the present study is to evaluate the effect of a subanesthetic dose of ketamine 24-hour post-injection on resting state functional connectivity, cognitive control, and reward learning.
study_population: We plan to recruit 30 TRD individuals with current MDD without psychotic features and 30 demographically matched healthy controls. All participants will be ketamine-naïve.
